name: Native XGBoost Explainability Engine
implementation_summary: Implemented native XGBoost pred_contribs explainability engine. Generated top positive/negative contributors, deterministic security evidence from features, threat intel reuse, and correct NaN handling (JSON null) without retraining or changing predictions.
known_limitations: Explainability depends on extracted HTML/URL features, so if extraction fails completely, the engine relies on default values.
Network requests during feature extraction still govern the overall response time.

rollback.instructions: Delete backend/services/explainability_service.py and backend/tests/test_explainability.py. Revert backend/schemas/response_models.py, backend/services/prediction_service.py, and backend/routes/predict.py to previous state.
